units.passage: The use of generative AI is permitted for data analysis and computation, as well as for research.
units.why: Example statement 2: "The use of generative AI is permitted for data analysis and computation, as well as for research." Data analysis permission, P89.

units.passage: manipulating spreadsheets and data
units.policy: Students might use generative AI in class for manipulating spreadsheets and data.
units.why: "manipulating spreadsheets and data" is AI for data work, P89. It appears in a list of ideas, so modality is may and the stance permit.

units.passage: or for calculations only as specified in the HWs, but not for generating ideas and the structure of the solutions.
units.why: 'or for calculations only as specified in the HWs, but not for generating ideas and the structure of the solutions' allows calculation only when specified and bars idea generation; P89 for the calculation permission, noting the added ban.
units.fit_note: Also forbids AI for generating ideas and the structure of solutions.

units.passage: Analyzing data
units.policy: A template exception may allow analyzing data.
units.why: Template exception: AI analyzes data (P89).

units.passage: Finding data for analysis
units.policy: A template exception may allow finding data for analysis.
units.why: Template exception: AI finds data for analysis (P89).

units.passage: Generating visual materials (graphs, slides, images, etc.)
units.policy: A template exception may allow generating visual materials (graphs, slides, images, etc.).
units.why: Template exception: AI generates graphs, slides, images. Closest is P89 (visualization), though it extends to slides and images.
units.fit_note: Includes slides and images beyond data visualization.

units.passage: Get familiar with generative AI before using: AI can assist with data analysis, generate ideas, or help structure your thoughts.
units.why: "AI can assist with data analysis" names a permitted use, P89.

units.passage: For example, students and instructors may use LLMs in an explanatory capacity or use LLMs to synthesize code to support data analysis and visualizations.
units.why: Students and instructors 'may use LLMs in an explanatory capacity or ... to synthesize code to support data analysis and visualizations'; data analysis and visualization is P89. The tutoring use is also P12, not chosen since data/visualization is the specific permission.

units.passage: AI significantly advances research capabilities by automating data analysis, optimizing experimental designs, and enabling the exploration of vast datasets that would otherwise be unmanageable manually.
units.why: 'AI significantly advances research capabilities by automating data analysis' says AI helps analyze data (P89).
units.fit_note: A benefit statement rather than permission.

units.passage: Research and Development: AI can be used to support research activities, including data analysis, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling. Researchers can leverage AI to gain insights and advance knowledge in various ﬁelds of study.
units.why: AI 'can be used to support research activities, including data analysis, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling', an allowed use for analyzing data (P89).

units.passage: It does allow use of AI to generate ideas, outlines, and drafts; summarize articles; provide insights into data; and provide feedback on writing, coding, and problem-solving
units.why: 'provide insights into data' is an allowed use, P89.

units.passage: It may also help guide you while creating Alteryx workflows and preparing data visualization in Power BI
units.policy: It may also help guide you while creating Alteryx workflows and preparing data visualization in Power BI.
units.why: Business example: 'creating Alteryx workflows and preparing data visualization in Power BI' names data-visualization help, P89.

units.passage: Interpreting, analyzing and strategizing with data
units.why: The list item 'Interpreting, analyzing and strategizing with data' names data analysis as an effective AI use, matching P89.
units.fit_note: Framed as potential effective uses, not a permission.

units.passage: Use of GAI to brainstorm and conduct preliminary research for assignments. Use of GAI to summarize articles and other readings. Use of GAI to analyze quantitative or qualitative data.
units.policy: Course policies may define as a permitted use: GAI to analyze quantitative or qualitative data.
units.why: Example use "analyze quantitative or qualitative data" matches P89. It is listed among uses a course policy could define.

units.passage: Analyze data, text, images, or other materials (when the assignment is designed to evaluate AI-supported methods);
units.why: Conditionally permitted: 'Analyze data, text, images ... (when the assignment is designed to evaluate AI-supported methods)'; P89.

units.passage: Mathematical and Statistical Analysis, Data Analysis, Data Interpretation, Coding of Data, generalizing data to a problem set or any other forms of quantification of language or concepts, etc.: Generative AI can be used for these purposes; however, the output must be verified via your own mathematical calculations and proof of work provided in your assignment.
units.policy: Generative AI can be used for mathematical and statistical analysis, data analysis, data interpretation, coding of data and other forms of quantification of language or concepts.
units.why: Lists math, statistical and data analysis and says 'Generative AI can be used for these purposes': the data-analysis permission P89.
units.fit_note: Verification condition is coded separately. | Adds the condition that output be verified by the student's own calculations with proof of work.

units.passage: Unless you are analyzing publicly available data, you should use extreme caution when using AI tools to analyze data.
units.why: 'you should use extreme caution when using AI tools to analyze data' limits AI data analysis, so it fits P89 as a restricted permission.
units.fit_note: Allowed conditionally; public data preferred, otherwise de-identification.

units.passage: Análisis de datos preliminares o resúmenes de investigación generados por la IA.
units.why: Level 3 example activities include "Análisis de datos preliminares o resúmenes de investigación generados por la IA", data analysis with AI (P89).

units.passage: En los cursos que involucren la creación de multimedios, el diseño de simulaciones o el análisis de datos, el uso de la IA será permitido, siempre que cumpla con las políticas de transparencia y el propósito académico de la actividad o tarea.
units.why: "el uso de la IA será permitido" in multimedia, simulation and data-analysis courses if transparent; permission for data analysis (P89).
units.fit_note: Also covers multimedia creation and simulation design, conditioned on transparency and academic purpose. | Covers multimedia creation and simulations as well as data analysis, conditioned on transparency and academic purpose.

units.passage: GenAI can help explore scientific questions, identify patterns, test hypotheses and make sense of non-sensitive data, as part of the learning process.
units.why: "GenAI can help explore scientific questions, identify patterns, test hypotheses and make sense of non-sensitive data" allows data exploration and analysis as part of learning; P89.

units.passage: that student can use an AI - they can copy everything into a spreadsheet and ask an AI to subtract the numbers in column A from column B.
units.why: The Convenience section says a student can 'copy everything into a spreadsheet and ask an AI to subtract the numbers', an example of a tedious task AI may do, so P89 is nearest.
units.fit_note: The example is routine convenience arithmetic in a spreadsheet, not analysis or visualization of data.

units.passage: Data analysis
units.why: 'Data analysis' is a listed permitted purpose: P89.

units.passage: Textual comparison and analysis
units.why: "Textual comparison and analysis" is analysis of material, closest to P89.
units.fit_note: Analysis of text rather than data.

units.passage: Analyze large datasets from experiments, identifying patters and generating visualizations.
units.why: 'Analyze large datasets from experiments, identifying patters and generating visualizations' (P89).

units.passage: analyzing data
units.why: Listed specific usage 'analyzing data' is a permissible AI task (P89); instructor, during-work, may.

units.passage: To support research: finding, generating, and analyzing data quickly; encouraging multimodal approaches to communication (e.g., generating websites or posters)
units.why: 'finding, generating, and analyzing data quickly' is a listed student use for research and data analysis (P89).
